prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any person acting on your behalf.

Kindly provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Please preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data recorder downloads, dash camera footage, recorded calls, and any surveillance or third-party reports in your possession. Routine deletion or disposal of these materials should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
